entries.title: Genesis 31:1
segments: ¶Now [Jacob] heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, "Jacob has taken away all that was our father's, and from what was our father's he has acquired all this wealth."

entries.title: Genesis 31:2
segments: And Jacob saw the countenance of Laban, and indeed it [was] not [favorable] toward him as before.

entries.title: Genesis 31:3
segments: Then the LORD said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your fathers and to your family, and I will be with you."

entries.title: Genesis 31:4
segments: So Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field, to his flock,

entries.title: Genesis 31:5
segments: and said to them, "I see your father's countenance, that it [is] not [favorable] toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

entries.title: Genesis 31:6
segments: "And you know that with all my might I have served your father.

entries.title: Genesis 31:7
segments: "Yet your father has deceived me and changed my wages ten times, but God did not allow him to hurt me.

entries.title: Genesis 31:8
segments: "If he said thus: 'The speckled shall be your wages,' then all the flocks bore speckled. And if he said thus: 'The streaked shall be your wages,' then all the flocks bore streaked.

entries.title: Genesis 31:9
segments: "So God has taken away the livestock of your father and given [them] to me.

entries.title: Genesis 31:10
segments: "And it happened, at the time when the flocks conceived, that I lifted my eyes and saw in a dream, and behold, the rams which leaped upon the flocks [were] streaked, speckled, and gray-spotted.

entries.title: Genesis 31:11
segments: "Then the Angel of God spoke to me in a dream, saying, 'Jacob.' And I said, 'Here I am.'

entries.title: Genesis 31:12
segments: "And He said, 'Lift your eyes now and see, all the rams which leap on the flocks [are] streaked, speckled, and gray-spotted; for I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.

entries.title: Genesis 31:13
segments: 'I [am] the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar [and] where you made a vow to Me. Now arise, get out of this land, and return to the land of your family.'"

entries.title: Genesis 31:14
segments: Then Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, "Is there still any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

entries.title: Genesis 31:15
segments: "Are we not considered strangers by him? For he has sold us, and also completely consumed our money.

entries.title: Genesis 31:16
segments: "For all these riches which God has taken from our father are [really] ours and our children's; now then, whatever God has said to you, do it."

entries.title: Genesis 31:17
segments: ¶Then Jacob rose and set his sons and his wives on camels.

entries.title: Genesis 31:18
segments: And he carried away all his livestock and all his possessions which he had gained, his acquired livestock which he had gained in Padan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 31:19
segments: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and Rachel had stolen the household idols that were her father's.

entries.title: Genesis 31:20
segments: And Jacob stole away, unknown to Laban the Syrian, in that he did not tell him that he intended to flee.

entries.title: Genesis 31:21
segments: So he fled with all that he had. He arose and crossed the river, and headed toward the mountains of Gilead.

entries.title: Genesis 31:22
segments: And Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.

entries.title: Genesis 31:23
segments: Then he took his brethren with him and pursued him for seven days' journey, and he overtook him in the mountains of Gilead.

entries.title: Genesis 31:24
segments: But God had come to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said to him, "Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad."

entries.title: Genesis 31:25
segments: ¶So Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountains, and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mountains of Gilead.

entries.title: Genesis 31:26
segments: And Laban said to Jacob: "What have you done, that you have stolen away unknown to me, and carried away my daughters like captives [taken] with the sword?

entries.title: Genesis 31:27
segments: "Why did you flee away secretly, and steal away from me, and not tell me; for I might have sent you away with joy and songs, with timbrel and harp?

entries.title: Genesis 31:28
segments: "And you did not allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters. Now you have done foolishly in [so] doing.

entries.title: Genesis 31:29
segments: "It is in my power to do you harm, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, 'Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad.'

entries.title: Genesis 31:30
segments: "And now you have surely gone because you greatly long for your father's house, [but] why did you steal my gods?"

entries.title: Genesis 31:31
segments: Then Jacob answered and said to Laban, "Because I was afraid, for I said, 'Perhaps you would take your daughters from me by force.'

entries.title: Genesis 31:32
segments: "With whomever you find your gods, do not let him live. In the presence of our brethren, identify what I have of yours and take [it] with you." For Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.

entries.title: Genesis 31:33
segments: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, into Leah's tent, and into the two maids' tents, but he did not find [them]. Then he went out of Leah's tent and entered Rachel's tent.

entries.title: Genesis 31:34
segments: Now Rachel had taken the household idols, put them in the camel's saddle, and sat on them. And Laban searched all about the tent but did not find [them].

entries.title: Genesis 31:35
segments: And she said to her father, "Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise before you, for the manner of women [is] with me." And he searched but did not find the household idols.

entries.title: Genesis 31:36
segments: ¶Then Jacob was angry and rebuked Laban, and Jacob answered and said to Laban: "What [is] my trespass? What [is] my sin, that you have so hotly pursued me?

entries.title: Genesis 31:37
segments: "Although you have searched all my things, what part of your household things have you found? Set [it] here before my brethren and your brethren, that they may judge between us both!

entries.title: Genesis 31:38
segments: "These twenty years I [have been] with you; your ewes and your female goats have not miscarried their young, and I have not eaten the rams of your flock.

entries.title: Genesis 31:39
segments: "That which was torn [by beasts] I did not bring to you; I bore the loss of it. You required it from my hand, [whether] stolen by day or stolen by night.

entries.title: Genesis 31:40
segments: "[There] I was! In the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night, and my sleep departed from my eyes.

entries.title: Genesis 31:41
segments: "Thus I have been in your house twenty years; I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.

entries.title: Genesis 31:42
segments: "Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty-handed. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked [you] last night."

entries.title: Genesis 31:43
segments: ¶And Laban answered and said to Jacob, "[These] daughters [are] my daughters, and [these] children [are] my children, and [this] flock [is] my flock; all that you see [is] mine. But what can I do this day to these my daughters or to their children whom they have borne?

entries.title: Genesis 31:44
segments: "Now therefore, come, let us make a covenant, you and I, and let it be a witness between you and me."

entries.title: Genesis 31:45
segments: So Jacob took a stone and set it up [as] a pillar.

entries.title: Genesis 31:46
segments: Then Jacob said to his brethren, "Gather stones." And they took stones and made a heap, and they ate there on the heap.

entries.title: Genesis 31:47
segments: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

entries.title: Genesis 31:48
segments: And Laban said, "This heap [is] a witness between you and me this day." Therefore its name was called Galeed,

entries.title: Genesis 31:49
segments: also Mizpah, because he said, "May the LORD watch between you and me when we are absent one from another.

entries.title: Genesis 31:50
segments: "If you afflict my daughters, or if you take [other] wives besides my daughters, [although] no man [is] with us-see, God [is] witness between you and me!"

entries.title: Genesis 31:51
segments: Then Laban said to Jacob, "Here is this heap and here is [this] pillar, which I have placed between you and me.

entries.title: Genesis 31:52
segments: "This heap [is] a witness, and [this] pillar [is] a witness, that I will not pass beyond this heap to you, and you will not pass beyond this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

entries.title: Genesis 31:53
segments: "The God of Abraham, the God of Nahor, and the God of their father judge between us." And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 31:54
segments: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain, and called his brethren to eat bread. And they ate bread and stayed all night on the mountain.

entries.title: Genesis 31:55
segments: And early in the morning Laban arose, and kissed his sons and daughters and blessed them. Then Laban departed and returned to his place.
